Thoughtful therapy for meaningful change

I offer short- and long-term psychotherapy grounded in evidence and shaped to your life. I work with adults on anxiety, trauma, relationships, burnout, and life transitions.

Led by {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}} — confidential, client-centered care in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Connect — {{PHONE}}

Common misconceptions about therapy

Myth: Therapy is only for crisis

Truth: Therapy helps both in crises and in quieter moments of growth. I help people prepare for transitions and develop tools before stress escalates.

Myth: You’ll be told what to do

Truth: My role is to guide and co-investigate, supporting your autonomy and practical decision-making.

Myth: Progress should be linear

Truth: Change is iterative. We track small markers and adapt approaches as needed.

Core principles that shape my work

Evidence-informed

I integrate cognitive-behavioral, trauma-informed, and interpersonal approaches tailored to your needs. Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}.

Collaborative clarity

We define clear goals together and review progress regularly so therapy stays relevant and practical.

Context-aware

Therapy considers relationships, work, culture, and identity. Treatment plans respect your values and constraints.

Short casevignettes (anonymized)

Reconnecting after burnout

Client: mid-career professional feeling depleted. Process: paced workload adjustments, boundary practice, values exploration. Outcome: clearer priorities and sustainable routines over months.

Anxiety and daily functioning

Client: generalized worry impacting sleep. Process: skill-building (breathwork, cognitive restructuring), graded exposure. Outcome: improved sleep and reduced avoidance in weeks.

Repairing a relationship pattern

Client: recurring conflicts with partner. Process: communication experiments, empathy practices, systems mapping. Outcome: clearer needs and fewer escalations.

Frequently asked — practical answers

How do I start?

Use the booking link to request a 20-minute consult or email me at {{EMAIL}}. We’ll clarify fit, scheduling, and any initial questions.

Do you offer remote sessions?

Yes. I provide telehealth throughout {{STATE}} and in-person sessions in {{CITY}} when available. We’ll review technology and privacy at intake.

What if I’m in crisis?

If you are at immediate risk of harm, contact local emergency services or a crisis line. I do not provide emergency services through this site.

Ready to take a next step?

If it feels like a reasonable next step, click to schedule a short consult. We’ll check fit, logistics, and boundaries before committing to ongoing sessions.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Email — {{EMAIL}}

Confidentiality note: Sessions are confidential except where disclosure is required by law (harm to self/others, abuse of a minor). Scope: I provide psychotherapy for adults and do not offer forensic evaluations. All contact is subject to standard therapeutic boundaries.
